Kabut tersebut memberikan 135 (+45% bonus Serangan Fisik) Physical Damage kepada musuh di area tersebut setiap 0,5 detik (hingga 4 kali). Kabut tersebut juga memperlambat musuh di area tersebut sebesar 40%. Kerusakan ini dianggap sebagai kerusakan serangan dasar, tetapi tidak dapat menjadi serangan kritis.
skills.original_description: Hanekage dashes in the target direction, knocking enemies in his path into the air for 0.4 sec and dealing 405 (+45% bonus Physical Attack) physical damage (recovers 200 energy if he hits an enemy hero), leaving a dark mist in the area he passes through. The mist deals 135 (+45% bonus physical attack) physical damage to enemies in the area every 0.5 sec (up to 4 times). It also slows enemies in the area by 40%. This damage is considered basic attack damage, but cannot be critical.

skills.name: Ninjutsu Flee: Return
skills.description: Hanekage kembali ke tubuh Hanzo dan meninggalkan wujud Hanekage.
skills.original_description: Hanekage returns to Hanzo's body and leaves the Hanekage form.

skills.name: Key Insight
skills.description: Harith memperoleh 7% Hybrid Lifesteal untuk setiap Hero lawan di dekatnya, hingga maksimal 35%.
skills.original_description: Harith takes a glimpse of his key. He gains 7% hybrid lifesteal for each nearby enemy hero, stacking up to 35%.

skills.name: Synchro Fission
skills.description: Harith menciptakan bayangan dirinya di lokasi yang jauh. Harith dan bayangannya kemudian akan saling melancarkan serangan Synchro Fission, yang akan memberikan kerusakan kepada semua unit musuh yang berada di jalurnya. Ketika kedua gelombang energi tersebut bertabrakan, terjadi ledakan yang berdampak pada semua musuh di area ledakan.
skills.original_description: Harith creates a ghost of himself in a distant location. Harith and his ghost will then cast Synchro Fission at each other, dealing to all enemy units in the path. When the 2 energy waves collide, an explosion occurs, affecting all enemies in the explosion area.

skills.name: Chrono Dash
skills.description: Harith menerjang ke arah yang ditentukan. Saat tiba, ia mencuri Magic Power dari Hero lawan, menciptakan perisai, dan memperkuat serangan dasar berikutnya. Nilai penyerapan perisai dan damage serangan dasar yang diperkuat tidak dicantumkan dalam sumber. Serangan dasar yang diperkuat memperlambat musuh sebesar 40%. Mengenai musuh dengan serangan tersebut mengurangi Cooldown Chrono Dash sebesar 3 detik.
skills.original_description: Harith rushes towards the target direction. When he arrives, he steals magic power from enemy heroes, generates a shield that at least absorbs damage, and enhances his next basic attack. Harith's improved basic attack deals and slows enemies by 40%. Hitting an enemy with Harith's Improved Basic Attack reduces the cooldown of Chrono Dash by 3 seconds.

skills.name: Zaman Force
skills.description: Harith menggunakan kuncinya untuk memanggil Zaman Force. Saat Multidimensional Rift muncul, waktu cooldown Chrono Dash berkurang sebesar 4 detik. Awalnya, Rift ini memperlambat Pahlawan musuh di area tersebut sebesar 70%, dan kemudian akan terus memperlambat Pahlawan musuh sebesar 35%. Jika Harith bersentuhan dengan Celah tersebut menggunakan Chrono Dash, ia akan menyerap energi di dalamnya dan mengurangi waktu cooldown Synchro Fission sebesar 1 detik serta Chrono Dash sebesar 3 detik. Harith mendapatkan ketahanan sebesar 15% selama berada di dalam Celah.
skills.original_description: Harith uses his key to summon the Zaman Force. When the Multidimensional Rift appears, Chrono Dash's cooldown is reduced by 4 seconds. The Rift initially slows enemy Heroes in the area by 70% and will then continually slow enemy Heroes by 35%. If Harith comes into contact with the rift using Chrono Dash, he will absorb the energy inside and reduce the cooldown of Synchro Fission by 1 second and Chrono Dash by 3 seconds. Harith gains 15% resilience while on the Rift.

skills.name: Magic Master
skills.description: Penguasaan sihir Harley memungkinkan serangan dasarnya memberikan 60 (+50% dari total serangan fisik) (+60% dari total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Serangannya mengurangi Pertahanan Sihir musuh sebesar 2 selama 3 detik saat mengenai sasaran (maksimal 10 tumpukan).
skills.original_description: Harley's magic mastery allows her basic attack to deal 60 (+50% of total physical attack)(+60% of total magic power) magic damage. His attacks reduce the enemy's Magic Defense by 2 for 3 seconds when hit (up to 10 stacks).

skills.name: Poker Trick
skills.description: Harley melemparkan 3–5 gelombang kartu ke arah target, masing-masing memberikan 130–210 (+25% total Kekuatan Sihir) Magic Damage kepada musuh pertama yang terkena dan memberikan tambahan Kecepatan Serangan sebesar 10% selama 3 detik setelahnya (hingga 5–10 tumpukan). Musuh yang terkena lebih dari 3 kali akan menerima kerusakan yang lebih sedikit dari serangan berikutnya.
skills.original_description: Harley throws 3-5 waves of cards in the target direction, each dealing 130-210 (+25% total Magic Power) magic damage to the first enemy hit and granting them 10% more Attack Speed ​​for 3 seconds afterward (up to 5-10 stacks). Enemies hit more than 3 times will take less damage from subsequent hits.

skills.name: Space Escape
skills.description: Harley melompat ke arah yang ditunjukkan, meninggalkan sebuah topi ajaib di tempatnya, sehingga kecepatan geraknya meningkat sebesar 30% selama 2 detik. Penggunaan ulang: Gunakan lagi dalam waktu 4 detik untuk kembali ke lokasi topi tersebut dan efek peningkatan kecepatan akan hilang.
skills.original_description: Harley blinks in the direction shown, leaving a magic hat in its place, increasing her movement speed by 30% for 2 seconds. Reuse: Use again within 4 seconds to return to where the hat is and lose the speed boost.

skills.name: Deadly Magic
skills.description: Harley melemparkan cincin api sihir ke arah pahlawan musuh yang menjadi sasaran (dapat diblokir oleh pahlawan lain), yang menimbulkan 200–400 (+60% total Magic Power) Magic Damage dan memperlambat pergerakan musuh sebesar 40% selama 1,5 detik. Cincin sihir tersebut akan tetap berada di sekitar musuh selama 4 detik, dan selama itu Harley dapat menyerang cincin sihir tersebut untuk memberikan kerusakan kepada musuh menggunakan kemampuannya. Cincin sihir tersebut akan meledak pada akhir durasi, memberikan 100-200 (+30% total Magic Power) ditambah 50% dari kerusakan yang diterima musuh selama durasi tersebut sebagai Magic Damage.
skills.original_description: Harley throws a ring of magic fire at the targeted enemy hero (can be blocked by other heroes), dealing 200-400 (+60% total magic power) magic damage and Slowing them by 40% for 1.5 seconds. The magic ring stays around the enemy for 4 seconds, during which Harley can hit the magic ring to damage the enemy with her skills. The magic ring will explode at the end of the duration, dealing 100-200 (+30% total magic power) plus 50% of the damage taken by the enemy during the duration as magic damage.

skills.name: Ninjutsu: Trace of Shadow
skills.description: Serangan Hayabusa memberikan satu tumpukan Shadow Mark pada target yang terkena (maksimal 4 tumpukan). Setiap tumpukan bertahan selama 6 detik dan meningkatkan kerusakan yang ditimbulkan Hayabusa kepada musuh sebesar 5%.
skills.original_description: Hayabusa's attacks apply a charge of Shadow Mark|mark to the hit (up to 4 charges). Each stack lasts 6 seconds and increases Hayabusa's damage to the enemy by 5%.

skills.name: Ninjutsu: Phantom Shuriken
skills.description: Hayabusa melemparkan tiga shuriken ke arah sasaran; masing-masing shuriken memberikan kerusakan kepada musuh yang terkena dan memperlambat gerakannya sebesar 35% selama 2 detik. Musuh yang terkena beberapa shuriken hanya akan menerima 30% kerusakan setelah serangan pertama. Hayabusa memulihkan 10 energi untuk setiap musuh non-minion yang terkena. Pasif: Hayabusa secara permanen memperoleh 3% hingga 18% Spell Vamp.
skills.original_description: Hayabusa throws three shurikens in the target direction, each dealing damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 35% for 2 seconds. Enemies hit by multiple shurikens only take 30% damage after the first hit. Hayabusa restores 10 energy for each non-minion enemy hit. Passive:|e Hayabusa permanently gains 3% to 18% Spell Vamp.

skills.name: Ninjutsu: Quad Shadow
skills.description: Hayabusa berlari kencang ke arah target dan melepaskan empat hantu yang bergerak ke berbagai arah. Hantu-hantu tersebut akan tetap berada di ujung jalurnya atau menempel pada pahlawan musuh pertama yang terkena, memberikan kerusakan serta memperlambat gerakannya sebesar 40% selama 2 detik. Hayabusa akan segera berhenti jika ia menabrak pahlawan musuh saat berlari kencang. Penggunaan Ulang: Hayabusa berteleportasi ke lokasi hantu dan mengurangi waktu cooldown Ninjutsu Phantom Shuriken sebesar 1 detik. Jika hantu tersebut menempel pada pahlawan musuh, hantu tersebut juga akan menyerang musuh tersebut.
skills.original_description: Hayabusa rushes in the target direction and releases four ghosts that move in different directions. The ghosts will either stay at the end of their path or attach to the first enemy hero hit, damaging them and slowing them by 40% for 2 seconds. Hayabusa will immediately stop if he hits an enemy hero while sprinting. Reuse:|e Hayabusa teleports to a ghost's location and reduces the cooldown of Ninjutsu Phantom Shuriken by 1 second. If the ghost is attached to an enemy hero, it also deals with the enemy.

skills.name: Ougi: Shadow Kill
skills.description: Hayabusa menyatu dengan bayangan dan melancarkan 6 serangan yang masing-masing mengincar satu target di area tersebut. Serangan memprioritaskan musuh yang memiliki Shadow Mark. Setiap serangan mengonsumsi satu Shadow Mark untuk memberikan Physical Damage tambahan. Bagian akhir deskripsi sumber menyebutkan larangan penerapan Shadow Mark, tetapi konteksnya tidak jelas.
skills.original_description: Hayabusa blends into the shadows and launches 6 single-target attacks at enemies in the area, each dealing damage. Attacks prioritize enemies with Shadow Mark|mark and each will consume a mark to deal additional physical damage. Do not apply the shadow mark.

skills.name: Shadow of Styx
skills.description: Helcurt tetap berada dalam status Prowler hingga terdeteksi oleh tim musuh, memperoleh tambahan kecepatan gerak sebesar 15% dan terus memulihkan HP-nya jika ia belum menimbulkan kerusakan. Ia memperoleh peningkatan Kecepatan Serangan sebesar 50% dan Kecepatan Gerak sebesar 50% (berkurang seiring waktu) selama 4 detik setelah terdeteksi, dan keluar dari status Prowler 0,75 detik kemudian. Setiap hero yang terbunuh setelah terkena serangan Helcurt akan meninggalkan kabut gelap yang meledak dan menyebar dengan cooldown 10 detik. Helcurt bersembunyi di dalam kabut gelap tersebut.
skills.original_description: Helcurt remains in the Prowler|e state until spotted by the enemy team, gaining 15% additional movement speed and continually regenerating his HP if he has dealt no damage. He gains 50% more Attack Speed ​​and 50% more Movement Speed ​​(decreasing over time) for 4 seconds after being spotted and exits the Prowler|e state 0.75 seconds later. Any hero killed after being hit by Helcurt leaves a dark fog that explodes and spreads with a 10 second cooldown. Helcurt hides in the dark fog.

skills.name: Hidden Terror
skills.description: Pasif: Saat Helcurt berada dalam kondisi Prowler, skill ini membuat pahlawan musuh yang terkena menjadi ketakutan dan waktu cooldown-nya berkurang 3 kali lebih cepat. Aktif: Helcurt melesat ke lokasi target dan memberikan damage kepada musuh di area tersebut, sekaligus mengurangi kecepatan gerak mereka sebesar 60% selama 0,75 detik.
skills.original_description: Passive: When Helcurt is in the Prowler state, the skill terrifies enemy heroes hit and its cooldown decreases 3 times faster. Active: Helcurt flashes to the target location and deals damage to enemies in the area, reducing their movement speed by 60% for 0.75 sec.

skills.name: Deadly Stinger
skills.description: Pasif: Helcurt memperoleh satu Deadly Stinger setiap 1,5 detik saat berada dalam status Prowler atau setiap kali melakukan serangan dasar. Maksimal 5 stinger dapat disimpan. Aktif: Helcurt menarik semua "Deadly Stinger" ke depan, dan masing-masing akan memberikan kerusakan kepada musuh (minion dan creep hanya menerima 70% kerusakan). "Deadly Stinger" dihitung sebagai serangan dasar, tetapi tidak dapat menghasilkan kritikal.
skills.original_description: Passive:|e Helcurt gains a Deadly Stinger every 1.5 sec spent in the Prowler|e state or with each basic attack. Up to 5 stingers can be stored. Active:|e Helcurt pulls all Deadly Stinger forward, dealing each to enemies (minons and Creeps only take 70% damage). Deadly Stinger counts as a basic attack, but it cannot crit.

skills.name: Dark Night Falls
skills.description: Helcurt mengaktifkan Black Night, yang mengurangi jangkauan penglihatan semua musuh dan membuat mereka tidak dapat melihat sekutu mereka selama 3 detik. Selama Dark Night, Helcurt mendapatkan peningkatan kecepatan gerak sebesar 40%. Black Night memudahkan Helcurt untuk keluar dari jangkauan penglihatan musuh.
skills.original_description: Helcurt invokes Black Night, reducing the sight range of all enemies and causing them to lose sight of their allies for 3 seconds. During Dark Night|E, Helcurt gains 40% movement speed. Black Night makes it easier for Helcurt to leave enemies' sight range.

skills.name: Blessing of Wilderness
skills.description: Hilda memulihkan 2% HP setiap detik saat berada di semak-semak. Saat memasuki semak-semak, serangan dasar berikutnya diperkuat, memberikan damage kepada target, mengurangi Movement Speed target sebesar 40%, dan memberikan damage kepada musuh di belakang target. Setelah digunakan, efek ini memiliki Cooldown 6 detik. Serangan dasar dan skill Hilda memberikan Desert Mark saat mengenai target. Tanda ini bertahan hingga 4 detik dan dapat ditumpuk hingga 6 kali. Setiap tumpukan mengurangi Physical Defense dan Magic Defense hero lawan sebesar 3%.
skills.original_description: Hilda recovers 2% HP per second while in the bush. Entering a bush enhances his next basic attack, which deals damage to the target, reduces the target's movement speed by 40%, and deals damage to enemies behind the target. After using the Improved Basic Attack, this effect goes into a 6 second cooldown. Hilda's basic attack and skills apply a mark of desert on a hit, which lasts up to 4 seconds and stacks up to 6. Each stack reduces the enemy hero's physical defense and magic defense by 3%.

skills.name: Combat Ritual
skills.description: Hilda memperoleh tambahan Movement Speed sebesar 60% selama 3 detik dan perisai yang menyerap damage sebesar 10% dari HP maksimum selama 3 detik.
skills.original_description: Hilda gains 60% movement speed for 3 seconds and receives a shield that absorbs damage equal to 10% of maximum HP for 3 seconds.

skills.name: Art of Hunting
skills.description: Hilda mengunci satu target musuh dan menyerangnya hingga maksimal 3 kali. Serangan kedua memberikan damage kepada musuh di sekitar target, sedangkan serangan ketiga mendorong target dan musuh di sekitarnya ke belakang untuk sementara.
skills.original_description: Hilda locks onto an enemy target and deals damage to them each time. The skill can be released a maximum of 3 times. The 2nd attack will deal damage to the surroundings of the target, and the 3rd attack will temporarily knock back the target and surrounding enemies.

skills.name: Power of Wildness
skills.description: Hilda melancarkan serangan kuat ke arah hero lawan, memberikan damage dan menyebabkan efek stun selama 0,2 detik. Musuh di sekitar target menerima 60% damage. Setiap tumpukan Wilderness Mark membuat skill ini memberikan damage tambahan sebesar 2,5% dari HP maksimum target. Pada jumlah tumpukan maksimum, damage tambahannya menjadi 20% dari HP maksimum target.
skills.original_description: Hilda [jumps forward and] launches a powerful attack at the target enemy, damaging and stunning them for 0.2 seconds. Nearby enemies also take 60% damage. Each stack of Wilderness Mark allows Power of Wildness to deal 2.5% of the target's maximum HP as additional damage. At maximum stacks, Power of Wildness deals 20% of the target's maximum HP as additional damage.

skills.name: Twin Fans: Ukifune
skills.description: Hirara hanya memiliki dua keterampilan, yang mewakili dua senjatanya: Meisen-e dan Kaerazu. Seret satu keterampilan ke keterampilan lainnya untuk melancarkan keterampilan kombo. Hirara memiliki 2 Energi Ungu / Kematian. Melancarkan keterampilan kombo menghabiskan 1 energi ungu/kematian. Waktu pemulihan energi sama dengan waktu cooldown Meisen-e. Penggunaan energi akan menghentikan proses pemulihan. Hirara hanya memberikan 30 (+4*level pahlawan)% kerusakan kepada minion.
skills.original_description: Hirara only has two skills, representing her two weapons: Meisen-e and Kaerazu. Drag one skill onto another to initiate a combo skill. Hirara has 2 Purple Energy / Death. Casting a combo skill consumes 1 purple/death energy. Energy recovery time is the same as Meisen-e's cooldown. Energy consumption interrupts the recovery process. Hirara only deals 30 (+4*hero level)% damage to minions.

skills.name: Meisen-e
skills.description: Hirara menaklukkan ombak dengan menggunakan Meisen-e, melakukan dua kali lompatan cepat menggunakan joystick (lompatan pertama mengarah ke arah yang dia hadapi). Dia menghabisi musuh-musuh yang terkena efeknya.
skills.original_description: Hirara rides the waves using Meisen-e, performing two joystick dashes (the first dash goes in the direction facing her). She takes care of affected enemies.

skills.name: Kaerazu
skills.description: Hirara menggunakan Kaerazu untuk melepaskan Crimson Maple, yang memberikan kerusakan kepada musuh-musuh di area berbentuk kipas. Setelah jeda singkat, serangan ini kembali memberikan kerusakan pada lokasi sasaran, dengan besaran 2 kali lipat dari kerusakan awal Crimson Maple.
skills.original_description: Hirara uses Kaerazu to release the Crimson Maple, dealing damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area. After a short delay, it deals damage again to the target location, dealing 2 times Crimson Maple's initial damage.

skills.name: Twin Fans: Ukifune
skills.description: Hirara hanya memiliki dua keterampilan, yang mewakili dua senjatanya: Meisen-e dan Kaerazu. Seret satu keterampilan ke keterampilan lainnya untuk melancarkan keterampilan kombo. Hirara memiliki 2 Energi Ungu / Kematian. Melancarkan keterampilan kombo menghabiskan 1 energi ungu/kematian. Waktu pemulihan energi sama dengan waktu cooldown Meisen-e. Penggunaan energi akan menghentikan proses pemulihan. Hirara hanya memberikan 30 (+4*level pahlawan)% kerusakan kepada minion.
skills.original_description: Hirara only has two skills, representing her two weapons: Meisen-e and Kaerazu. Drag one skill onto another to initiate a combo skill. Hirara has 2 Purple Energy / Death. Casting a combo skill consumes 1 purple/death energy. Energy recovery time is the same as Meisen-e's cooldown. Energy consumption interrupts the recovery process. Hirara only deals 30 (+4*hero level)% damage to minions.

skills.name: Falling Maple
skills.description: Hirara memperkuat Kaerazu dengan kekuatan Meisen-e untuk melancarkan skill kombo. Ia menjadi tidak dapat dijadikan target dan tidak dapat bergerak selama maksimal 1 detik. Setelah 0,6 detik, ia memberikan kerusakan sebesar 3 kali lipat dari Crimson Maple, dan kemudian dapat melemparkan joystick kedua Meisen-e untuk mengakhiri kondisi tersebut lebih awal.
skills.original_description: Hirara enhances Kaerazu with the power of Meisen-e to launch a combo skill. She becomes untargetable and immobilized for 1 second maximum. After 0.6 sec, she deals 3x the damage of Crimson Maple, and can then throw Meisen-e's second joystick to end these states early.

skills.name: Infernal Torrent
skills.description: Hirara memperkuat Meisen-e dengan kekuatan Kaerazu untuk melancarkan skill kombo. Setelah melemparkan joystick pertama Meisen-e, ia berputar, memberikan kerusakan sebesar 2,5 kali lipat dari Crimson Maple dan membekukan musuh selama 0,8 detik.
skills.original_description: Hirara enhances Meisen-e with Kaerazu's power to launch a combo skill. After throwing Meisen-e's first joystick, she spins, dealing 2.5 times the damage of Crimson Maple and rooting enemies for 0.8 seconds.

skills.name: Thickened Blood
skills.description: Hylos mendapatkan tambahan 1,5 HP Maksimum untuk setiap tambahan 1 Mana Maksimum yang dimilikinya. Saat mananya habis, Hylos dapat menggunakan HP-nya untuk melancarkan skill.
skills.original_description: Hylos gains 1.5 additional Max HP for each additional 1 Max Mana he possesses. When he runs out of mana, Hylos can use his HP to cast skills.

skills.name: Law and Order
skills.description: Hylos mendapatkan peningkatan kecepatan gerak sebesar 50% dan membuat serangan dasar berikutnya dalam waktu 3 detik mampu memberikan kerusakan, memantulkan mundur, serta membuat target terpaku selama 1 detik. Peningkatan kecepatan gerak tersebut berkurang dengan cepat seiring waktu dan berakhir setelah serangan dasar berikutnya.
skills.original_description: Hylos gains 50% movement speed and allows his next basic attack within 3 seconds to damage, knock back, and stun the target for 1 second. The bonus movement speed decreases quickly over time and ends after the next basic attack.

skills.name: Ring of Punishment
skills.description: Hylos melepaskan Ring of Punishment, yang memberikan kerusakan kepada musuh di sekitarnya setiap detik sekaligus memperlambat mereka sebesar 4–6% dan mengurangi kecepatan serangan mereka sebesar 7,5–15% selama 2,5 detik (hingga 8 tumpukan). Setiap tumpukan juga meningkatkan kerusakan yang ditimbulkan oleh Cincin Hukuman kepada musuh sebesar 5-20%. Cincin Hukuman menghabiskan 30 hingga 150 Mana per detik selama aktif. Gunakan Kembali; Hylos membatalkan Cincin Hukuman.
skills.original_description: Hylos unleashes the Ring of Punishment|E, dealing damage to nearby enemies per second while slowing them by 4-6% and reducing their attack speed by 7.5-15% for 2.5 seconds (up to 8 stacks). Each stack also increases the damage dealt to the enemy by the Ring of Punishment by 5-20%. The Ring of Punishment consumes 30 to 150 Mana per second while active. Reuse|e; Hylos cancels the Ring of Punishment.

skills.name: Glorious Pathway
skills.description: Hylos menciptakan jalur yang sangat luas ke arah yang ditargetkan, yang mengurangi kecepatan gerak musuh sebesar 75% selama 1 detik. Jalur tersebut bertahan selama 6 detik. Selama berada di jalur tersebut, Hylos kebal terhadap efek perlambatan dan memulihkan 3% dari HP maksimumnya per detik. Pahlawan sekutu yang bergerak di sepanjang jalur tersebut mendapatkan tambahan kecepatan gerak sebesar 60%, sedangkan pahlawan musuh yang berada di jalur tersebut akan diperlambat sebesar 25%.
skills.original_description: Hylos creates a huge path in the targeted direction, reducing enemies' movement by 75% for 1 second. The course lasts 6 seconds. While on the path, Hylos gains slow immunity and recovers 3% of his max HP} per second. Allied heroes moving along the path gain 60% additional movement speed, while enemy heroes on the path will be slowed by 25%.

skills.name: Jungle Heart
skills.description: Kerja sama Irithel dan Leo memungkinkan mereka menyerang sambil bergerak. Setiap serangan dasar melepaskan 2 anak panah busur silang, tetapi membutuhkan waktu pengisian ulang lebih lama. Setiap anak panah mewarisi 55% efek serangan. Serangan ini mengumpulkan Jungle Heart hingga maksimal 10 tumpukan. Serangan dasar berikutnya kemudian melepaskan 1 anak panah tambahan.
skills.original_description: Irithel and Leo's impeccable teamwork allows him to shoot on the move. Each basic attack will fire 2 crossbow bolts (but takes longer to reload) which deal per bolt (inherits part [55%] of attack effects). The move will build Jungle Heart, up to a maximum of 10 units, and cause the next basic attack to trigger 1 additional bolt(s).

skills.name: Strafe
skills.description: Irithel melepaskan rentetan panah ke area target, memberikan damage kepada musuh di dalamnya dan mengurangi Physical Defense mereka sebesar 15–40 selama 3 detik.
skills.original_description: Irithel launches a volley of arrows at the target area, damaging enemies within and reducing their physical defense by 15 to 40 for 3 seconds.

skills.name: Force of the Queen
skills.description: Leo mengeluarkan raungan kuat yang memberikan damage kepada musuh di sekitarnya dan mengurangi Movement Speed mereka sebesar 40% selama 2 detik.
skills.original_description: Leo lets out a piercing roar, dealing damage to nearby enemies and Slowing them by 40% for 2 seconds.

skills.name: Heavy Crossbow
skills.description: Irithel memerintahkan Leo melompat ke arah target dan memperkuat busur silangnya selama 10 detik. Selama durasi tersebut, Irithel memperoleh tambahan Movement Speed sebesar 30. Serangan dasarnya melepaskan anak panah yang diperkuat, memberikan damage kepada target dan unit di sekitarnya. Jungle Heart juga terkumpul lebih cepat. Besaran tambahan lainnya tidak dicantumkan dalam sumber.
skills.original_description: Irithel orders Leo to jump in the target direction and boosts his crossbow for 10 seconds. During this duration, she gains 30 additional movement speed and her basic attacks fire enhanced crossbow bolts, damaging the target and nearby units. Jungle Heart also stacks faster over the duration. [amount unknown]

skills.name: Siphon Starlium
skills.description: Serangan dasar dan kemampuan Ixia memberikan satu tumpukan Starlium Charge kepada musuh saat mengenai sasaran. Ketika Ixia melakukan serangan dasar terhadap musuh yang memiliki dua tumpukan Starlium Charge, serangan tersebut akan menghabiskan tumpukan tersebut dan digantikan dengan Siphon Starlium, yang memberikan kerusakan tambahan kepada target. Ixia memulihkan HP sebesar kerusakan yang ditimbulkan oleh Siphon Starlium (hanya % terhadap unit non-pahlawan). Siphon Starlium dapat terpicu pada musuh mana pun di depan Ixia yang berada dalam jangkauan serangan dasarnya, tetapi tidak dapat menimbulkan serangan kritis. Serangan dasar Ixia tidak dapat memicu lifesteal.
skills.original_description: Ixia's basic attacks and skills apply a stack of Starlium Charge|e to enemies when hit. When Ixia performs a basic attack on an enemy with two stacks of Starlium Charge, the attack will consume the charges and be replaced with Siphon Starlium|e, dealing a bonus to the target. Ixia recovers HP equal to the damage dealt by Siphon Starlium (only % against non-hero units). Siphon Starlium can trigger on any enemies in front of Ixia that are within range of its basic attack, but it cannot deal a critical hit. Ixia's basic attacks cannot trigger lifesteal.

skills.name: Dual Beam
skills.description: Ixia melepaskan 2 sinar energi bermuatan Starlium ke arah tanah sesuai arah sasaran, yang memberikan kerusakan kepada musuh di area berbentuk persegi panjang dan memperlambat Pahlawan musuh sebesar 40%. Saat mengenai Pahlawan musuh, Ixia juga mendapatkan peningkatan kecepatan gerak sebesar 40% selama 3 detik. Musuh yang terkena kedua sinar tersebut akan menerima kerusakan dua kali lipat.
skills.original_description: Ixia fires 2 Starlium-charged energy beams along the ground in the target direction, dealing damage to enemies in a rectangular area and slowing enemy Heroes by 40%. When hitting an enemy hero, Ixia also gains 40% movement speed for 3 seconds. Enemies hit by both beams will take double damage.

skills.name: Star Helix
skills.description: Ixia meluncurkan tabung energi Starlium ke arah sasaran, yang akan memantulkan musuh-musuh di sekitarnya ke belakang dan menarik musuh-musuh yang berada dalam jangkauan ke arah garis tengah setelah jeda singkat (sekitar 0,5 detik), sekaligus memberikan kerusakan kepada mereka.
skills.original_description: Ixia launches a Starlium energy canister in the target direction, knocking back nearby enemies and pulling enemies within range towards the midline after a short delay (approximately 0.5 seconds) and damaging them.

skills.name: Full Barrage
skills.description: Ixia membongkar senjatanya menjadi 6 senjata yang lebih kecil dan memasuki status Barrage selama 4 detik. Dalam status ini, serangan dasar dan skill Ixia dapat mengenai musuh dalam area berbentuk kipas yang luas, tetapi tidak di luar area tersebut. Serangan dasar Ixia dapat mengenai hingga 6 unit musuh (dengan prioritas pada hero), dan Siphon Starlium akan ditembakkan bersamaan dengan serangan dasarnya yang biasa.
skills.original_description: Ixia disassembles her weapon into 6 smaller weapons and enters the Barrage state for 4 seconds. In this state, Ixia's basic attacks and skills can hit enemies in a large fan-shaped area, but not outside. Ixia's basic attacks can hit up to 6 enemy units (prioritizing heroes), and Siphon Starlium will fire simultaneously with her normal basic attacks.

skills.name: Mecha Suppression
skills.description: Serangan Jawhead memberikan satu tumpukan Efek Penekanan Mecha saat mengenai sasaran (maksimal 10 tumpukan). Setiap tumpukan bertahan selama 3 detik dan meningkatkan kerusakan serangan dasar Jawhead terhadap musuh sebesar 8%.
skills.original_description: Jawhead's attacks apply a charge of Mecha Suppression on impact (up to 10 charges). Each stack lasts 3 seconds and increases the damage of Jawhead's basic attacks on the enemy by 8%.

skills.name: Smart Missiles
skills.description: Jawhead meluncurkan hingga 12 rudal secara acak ke arah musuh-musuh di sekitarnya selama 5 detik, dengan setiap rudal memberikan kerusakan kepada musuh yang terkena.
skills.original_description: Jawhead launches up to 12 missiles at random nearby enemies for 5 seconds, with each missile dealing damage to the enemy hit.

skills.name: Ejector
skills.description: Jawhead mendapatkan peningkatan kecepatan gerak sebesar 30% selama S detik. Penggunaan ulang: Jawhead mendorong unit terdekat (dengan prioritas pada Pahlawan) ke arah lokasi target, memberikan kerusakan kepada musuh di area tersebut, dan membuat mereka terpana selama 0,5 detik. Kemampuan ini dapat digunakan pada Pahlawan sekutu, dan mereka tidak akan menerima kerusakan.
skills.original_description: Jawhead gains 30% movement speed and one for S seconds. Reuse:|e Jawhead knocks the nearest unit (prioritizing Heroes) towards the target location, dealing damage to enemies in the area and stunning them for 0.5 seconds. Can be used on allied heroes and they will not take damage.

skills.name: Unstoppable Force
skills.description: Jawhead menerjang hero musuh yang menjadi target, memberikan damage dan menyebabkan stun singkat. Durasi stun tidak dicantumkan dalam sumber data. Musuh di sekitar target terdorong ke belakang dan menerima damage dengan jumlah yang sama. Jawhead kebal terhadap efek kontrol selama menerjang.
skills.original_description: Jawhead charges at the targeted enemy hero, inflicting and briefly stunning them. [duration unknown] Enemies around the target are knocked back and deal the same amount of damage. Jawhead is immune to control effects while charging.

skills.name: Electro Airbag
skills.description: Saat HP Johnson turun di bawah 30%, ia memperoleh perisai selama 10 detik. Besaran perisai tidak dicantumkan dalam sumber. Cooldown: 100 detik.
skills.original_description: When Johnson's HP drops below 30%, he gains one for 10 seconds. Cooldown: 100.0 seconds.

skills.name: Impact Wrench
skills.description: Johnson melemparkan kunci pas ke lokasi target, memberikan damage kepada musuh yang berada di jalurnya. Musuh di sekitar titik jatuh kunci pas terkena stun selama 0,8 detik.
skills.original_description: Johnson throws his wrench towards the target location, dealing damage to enemies in his path. Enemies around the landing point are stunned for 0.8 seconds.

skills.name: Electromagnetic Waves
skills.description: Johnson mengangkat perisainya dan terus memberikan damage kepada musuh dalam area berbentuk kipas ke arah target, sekaligus mengurangi Movement Speed mereka sebesar 20%. Setiap serangan meningkatkan damage skill berikutnya kepada musuh sebesar 15%, hingga maksimal 45%. Damage terhadap Creep meningkat sebesar 60%. Johnson tetap dapat menggunakan serangan dasar dan skill lain selama efek ini berlangsung.
skills.original_description: Johnson raises his shield, continuously dealing damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area in the target direction and slowing them by 20%. Each instance of damage also increases the enemy's subsequent damage caused by the skill by 15% (up to 45%). This damage is increased by 60% against creeps. Johnson can perform basic attacks and skills for the duration of the spell.

skills.name: Full Throttle
skills.description: Johnson berubah menjadi mobil dan terus meningkatkan kecepatannya. Satu hero sekutu dapat menggunakan Hop In di dekat Johnson untuk ikut naik ke mobil. Mobil meledak saat menabrak hero atau rintangan milik musuh, memberikan damage kepada musuh di sekitarnya dan menyebabkan stun selama 0,5–1 detik, bergantung pada kecepatan mobil sebelum tabrakan. Mobil juga menciptakan zona berlistrik yang terus memberikan damage dan efek slow kepada musuh di dalamnya. Saat mengemudi, tekan Brake untuk berhenti seketika atau tahan Nitrous untuk terus meningkatkan kecepatan hingga 5 detik. Lokasi Johnson terungkap kepada musuh selama 3 detik saat skill ini digunakan. Pasif: Physical Defense Johnson meningkat sebesar 10%–30%. Besaran kecepatan tambahan dan damage zona tidak dicantumkan dalam sumber.
skills.original_description: Johnson transforms into a car and begins to speed up over time. An allied hero can use Hop In|e near Johnson to board the car (only one allied hero can ride with Johnson). The car will explode when hitting a hero or enemy obstacle, dealing damage to nearby enemies. stunning them for 0.5 to 1 second (scales with the speed of the car before impact), [unknown speed] and creating an electrified zone at the location. The area continually deals and slows enemies in it. While in a car, press Brake to stop immediately or hold Nitrous to continuously gain speed for up to 5 seconds. Johnson's location will be revealed to the enemy for 3 seconds when casting this skill. Passive:|e Johnson's physical defense is increased by 10% to 30%.

skills.name: Humph, Joy's Angry!
skills.description: Joy menjadi marah setiap kali skill-nya mengenai musuh selain Minion. Efek ini memberikan 100 Magic Damage dan meningkatkan Movement Speed Joy sebesar 60%, yang berkurang secara bertahap selama 4 detik. Mengenai Leonin Crystal juga memicu peningkatan Movement Speed ini. Efek ini memiliki Cooldown 4 detik untuk setiap target. Keterangan mengenai efek serangan dasar Joy tidak lengkap dalam sumber.
skills.original_description: Joy becomes Angry!|E whenever her skill hits a non-minion enemy, dealing 100 magic damage and increasing her movement speed by 60% which decreases over 4 seconds (hitting the Leonin Crystal|E will also grant the movement speed effect). This effect has a cooldown of 4 seconds for each target. Joy's basic attack will deal.

skills.name: Look, Leonin Crystal!
skills.description: Joy memanggil Leonin Crystal ke lokasi target, memberikan damage kepada musuh di sekitarnya dan mengurangi Movement Speed mereka sebesar 30% selama 1 detik. Leonin Crystal bertahan selama 2 detik dan dapat digunakan sebagai titik pijakan untuk skill keduanya, Meow, Rhythm of Joy!.
skills.original_description: Joy summons a Leonin Crystal|E to the target location, dealing damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 30% for 1 second. The Leonine Crystal lasts 2 seconds and can be used as a springboard for its second skill, Meow, Rhythm of Joy!.

skills.name: Meow, Rhythm of Joy!
skills.description: Joy menerjang ke arah target dan memberikan damage kepada musuh yang dilewatinya. Jika mengenai musuh atau Leonin Crystal, Joy dapat menggunakan skill ini kembali dalam 0,8 detik dan memperoleh 1 Beat Energy. Jika digunakan sesuai irama, damage skill meningkat sebesar 100% dan Joy memperoleh perisai selama 3 detik. Skill ini dapat digunakan hingga 4 kali berturut-turut.
skills.original_description: Joy dashes in the target direction, dealing damage to enemies in her path. Hitting an enemy or the Leonin Crystal|E allows Joy to cast this skill again in 0.8 seconds and gain 1 Beat Energy. Casting this skill on beat increases the skill's damage by 100% and grants a shield that lasts for 3 seconds. This skill can be cast up to 4 times in a row.

skills.name: Ha, Electrifying Beats!
skills.description: Joy meningkatkan Physical Defense dan Magic Defense serta memperoleh tambahan Movement Speed sebesar 30%. Selama 4 detik berikutnya, skill ini menghasilkan 8 denyut yang masing-masing memberikan damage kepada musuh di sekitarnya. Setiap penggunaan Meow, Rhythm of Joy! sesuai irama meningkatkan damage skill ini sebesar 40%. Jika semua ketukan berhasil dilakukan dengan sempurna, Joy memperoleh 40% Spell Vamp selama skill ini aktif. Skill ini terbuka setelah Joy memperoleh Beat Energy. Jika digunakan dengan 3 Beat Energy, Joy menghapus semua debuff dan menjadi kebal terhadap efek slow selama skill ini aktif.
skills.original_description: Joy increases her physical and magical defense and gains 30% movement speed. Over the next 4 seconds, it pulses 8 times, each time damaging nearby enemies. Each Meow, Rhythm of Joy!|E cast on the rhythm increases the damage of this skill by 40%. If a perfect rhythm is achieved by hitting each beat with Meow, Rhythm of Joy!|E, Joy also gains 40% Spell Vamp while this skill is active. This skill is unlocked when Joy acquires Beat Energy|E. Casting this skill with 3 Beat Energy|E will remove all debuffs from Joy and make her immune to slow effects while this skill is active.

skills.name: Smith's Legacy
skills.description: Setelah menggunakan dua skill yang berbeda, Julian memperkuat skill ketiganya. Menggunakan skill yang diperkuat membuat semua skill-nya memiliki Cooldown 9–6 detik, berkurang sesuai level Julian. Setelah menggunakan skill, serangan dasar Julian selama 5 detik berikutnya memberikan damage dan menarik target ke arahnya. Menggunakan skill lain memperpanjang durasi efek ini. Julian memperoleh tambahan Hybrid Lifesteal sebesar 15% selama 5 detik setiap kali skill-nya mengenai hero lawan, hingga maksimal 3 tumpukan.
skills.original_description: After casting two different skills, Julian upgrades his third skill. Casting the upgraded skill makes all his skills work with a cooldown of 9 to 6 seconds (decreases with his level. After casting a skill, his basic attacks in the next 5 seconds to deal and pull the target towards him. Casting another skill extends the duration. Julian gains 15% additional hybrid lifesteal for 5 seconds every time he hits an enemy hero with his skills (up to 3 charges).

skills.name: Scythe
skills.description: Julian melemparkan sabit terbang ke arah target, memberikan damage kepada musuh yang dilewatinya dan mengurangi Movement Speed mereka sebesar 30% selama 1 detik. Sabit menghilang saat mengenai musuh selain Minion.
skills.original_description: Julian throws a flying scythe in the targeted direction, dealing damage to enemies along the way and slowing them by 30% for 1 second. The scythe disappears when hitting a non-minion enemy.

skills.name: Sword
skills.description: Julian memanggil pedang terbang dan menerjang ke arah target, memberikan damage kepada musuh yang dilewatinya.
skills.original_description: Julian summons a flying sword and rushes in the target direction, dealing damage to enemies along the way.

skills.name: Chain
skills.description: Julian melemparkan rantai ke lokasi target. Setelah jeda singkat, rantai memberikan 300 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage kepada musuh yang terkena dan menyebabkan efek Root selama 1,2 detik.
skills.original_description: Julian throws chains at the target location, dealing 300 (+100% total Magic Power) magic damage to enemies hit after a short delay and Rooting them for 1.2 seconds.

skills.name: Smith's Legacy
skills.description: Setelah menggunakan dua skill yang berbeda, Julian memperkuat skill ketiganya. Menggunakan skill yang diperkuat membuat semua skill-nya memiliki Cooldown 9–6 detik, berkurang sesuai level Julian. Setelah menggunakan skill apa pun, serangan dasar Julian selama 2 detik berikutnya memberikan 100 (+100% Total Physical Attack) (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage dan menarik target ke arahnya. Serangan ini memberikan 85% damage kepada Creep. Menggunakan skill lain memperpanjang durasi efek ini. Julian memperoleh tambahan Hybrid Lifesteal sebesar 15% selama 5 detik setiap kali skill-nya mengenai hero lawan, hingga maksimal 3 tumpukan.
skills.original_description: After casting two different skills, Julian upgrades his third skill. Casting the upgraded skill causes all of his skills to have a cooldown of 9 to 6 seconds (decreases with his level). After casting any skill, his basic attacks for the next 2 seconds will deal 100 (+100% of total physical attack) (+100% of total magic power) magic damage and pull the target towards him (deals 85% damage to Creeps). Casting another skill extends the duration. Julian gains 15% additional Hybrid Lifesteal for 5 seconds each time he hits an enemy Hero with his skills (up to 3 stacks).

skills.name: Enhanced Scythe
skills.description: Julian melemparkan sabit yang diperkuat ke arah target, memberikan 420 (+140% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage kepada musuh yang dilewatinya dan mengurangi Movement Speed mereka sebesar 50% selama 1 detik. Saat mengenai musuh selain Minion atau mencapai jarak maksimum, sabit terus terbang dengan kecepatan lebih rendah dan memberikan 80 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage kepada musuh di sekitarnya setiap 0,3 detik, hingga 8 kali.
skills.original_description: Julian throws enhanced scythes in the targeted direction, dealing 420 (+140% total magic power) magic damage to enemies along the way and slowing them by 50% for 1 second. When hitting a non-minion enemy or reaching maximum distance, scythes continue to fly at a slower speed, dealing 80 (+30% total magic power) magic damage every 0.3 sec to nearby enemies (up to 8 times).

skills.name: Enhanced Sword
skills.description: Julian memanggil banyak pedang terbang dan menerjang ke arah target, memberikan 75 (+15% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage kepada musuh di sepanjang jalurnya setiap 0,1 detik, hingga 9 kali. Selama menerjang, Julian tidak dapat dijadikan target dan tidak terlihat.
skills.original_description: Julian summons a large number of flying swords and rushes in the target direction, dealing 75 (+15% total magic power) magic damage every 0.1 sec to enemies along the way (up to 9 times). Julian is untargetable and invisible while running.

skills.name: Enhanced Chain
skills.description: Julian melemparkan rantai ke lokasi target, memberikan 40 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage kepada musuh yang terkena setiap 0,2 detik dan mengurangi Movement Speed mereka sebesar 30%. Musuh yang masih berada di area saat durasi skill berakhir menerima tambahan 250 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage dan terkena efek airborne selama 0,8 detik.
skills.original_description: Julian throws chains at the target location, dealing 40 (+10% total magic power) magic damage every 0.2 sec to enemies hit and Slowing them by 30%. Enemies that are still in the area at the end of the skill's duration will take 250 (+100% total Magic Power) additional Magic Damage and be knocked into the air for 0.8 seconds.

skills.name: Thalassophobia
skills.description: Kadita memperoleh Ocean's Blessing setiap 30 detik. Berkah ini aktif saat Kadita menerima damage dari hero lawan dan berlangsung selama 4 detik. Selama durasi tersebut, Kadita memulihkan 65% HP yang hilang.
skills.original_description: Kadita gains Ocean's Blessing every 30 seconds. The blessing triggers when she takes damage from enemy heroes and lasts for 4 seconds, allowing her to recover 65% of lost HP for the next duration.

skills.name: Ocean Ode
skills.description: Kadita memanggil gelombang laut yang bergerak menuju arah target lalu kembali, memberikan damage kepada musuh yang terkena dan mengurangi Movement Speed mereka sebesar 30%. Saat berada di dalam gelombang, Kadita kebal terhadap efek kontrol dan memperoleh 50% pengurangan damage. Skill ini dapat melewati rintangan dan medan. Gunakan kembali untuk keluar dari gelombang tanpa menghentikan pergerakannya.
skills.original_description: Kadita summons an ocean wave to move in the target direction and back, dealing damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30%. While inside the wave, she gains control immunity and 50% damage reduction. This skill can traverse obstacles and terrain. Use again: Kadita leaves the wave without interrupting the wave's movement.

skills.name: Breath of the Ocean
skills.description: Setelah jeda singkat, Kadita memanggil gelombang laut yang meledak di lokasi target, memberikan damage kepada musuh yang terkena dan menyebabkan efek airborne selama 1 detik. Kadita juga dapat menggunakan skill ini saat Ocean Ode aktif untuk memanggil gelombang di bawah dirinya dengan jeda ledakan yang lebih singkat.
skills.original_description: After a short delay, Kadita summons an ocean wave that erupts at the target location, dealing damage to enemies hit and knocking them into the air for 1 second. Kadita can cast this skill during Ocean Ode to summon an ocean wave beneath her with a shorter eruption delay.

skills.name: Rough Waves
skills.description: Kadita menyelam ke dalam tanah dan melepaskan gelombang laut ke segala arah. Setiap gelombang memberikan damage kepada musuh yang terkena dan mengurangi Movement Speed mereka sebesar 30%. Musuh yang terkena beberapa gelombang menerima damage lebih besar. Setelah beberapa saat, gelombang kembali ke Kadita dan masing-masing memberikan damage kepada musuh yang terkena. Saat menyelam, Kadita kebal terhadap gangguan kecuali Suppression. Ia juga tidak dapat dijadikan target dan memperoleh tambahan Movement Speed sebesar 60%.
skills.original_description: Kadita dives into the ground and sends ocean waves in all directions, each damaging enemies hit and slowing them by 30%. Enemies hit by multiple waves take increased damage. After a short period, the waves return to Kadita, each dealing damage to enemies hit. When diving underground, Kadita cannot be interrupted (except Suppression). While underground, Kadita becomes untargetable and gains 60% movement speed.

skills.name: Yin Yang Gathering
skills.description: Setelah mengambil Payung Seimei, Kagura memperoleh satu efek tambahan, menyebabkan stun kepada musuh di sekitarnya selama 0,5 detik dan mengurangi Movement Speed mereka sebesar 60% selama 1 detik. Cooldown: 4,5 detik.
skills.original_description: Upon collecting the Seimei Umbrella, Kagura gains one, stuns nearby enemies for 0.5 seconds and slows them by 60% for 1 second. Cooldown 4.5 seconds.

skills.name: Seimei Umbrella Open
skills.description: Kagura melemparkan Payung Seimei ke lokasi target, memberikan damage kepada musuh yang dilewatinya dan mengurangi Movement Speed mereka sebesar 60% selama 0,5 detik. Payung otomatis kembali kepada Kagura jika jaraknya terlalu jauh. Skill ini memberikan 130% damage kepada musuh selain hero.
skills.original_description: Kagura sends the Seimei Umbrella to the target location, dealing damage to enemies in its path and slowing them by 60% for 0.5 seconds. The Umbrella will automatically return to Kagura when she is too far away. This skill deals 130% damage to non-hero enemies.

skills.name: Rasho Umbrella Flee
skills.description: Kagura menghapus semua debuff yang mengenainya lalu berlari ke arah target, meninggalkan Payung Seimei di belakang.
skills.original_description: Kagura removes all debuffs on her and rushes in the target direction, while leaving the Seimei Umbrella behind.

skills.name: Yin Yang Overturn
skills.description: Kagura memanggil kekuatan Payung Seimei, memberikan damage kepada musuh di sekitarnya, mendorong mereka menjauh, dan mengurangi Movement Speed mereka sebesar 60% selama 0,5 detik.
skills.original_description: Kagura summons the power of the Seimei Umbrella, dealing damage to nearby enemies, knocking them back, and slowing them by 60% for 0.5 seconds.

skills.name: Yin Yang Gathering
skills.description: Setelah mengambil Payung Seimei, Kagura memperoleh perisai sebesar 450 (+80% Total Magic Power), menyebabkan stun kepada musuh di sekitarnya selama 0,5 detik dan mengurangi Movement Speed mereka sebesar 60% selama 1 detik. Cooldown: 4,5 detik.
skills.original_description: After collecting the Seimei Umbrella, Kagura gains a shield of 450 (+80% total magic power), stuns nearby enemies for 0.5 seconds, and slows them by 60% for 1 second. Cooldown: 4.5s.

skills.name: Seimei Umbrella Open
skills.description: Kagura melemparkan Payung Seimei ke lokasi target, memberikan 365 (+105% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage kepada musuh yang dilewatinya dan mengurangi Movement Speed mereka sebesar 60% selama 0,5 detik. Payung otomatis kembali kepada Kagura jika jaraknya terlalu jauh. Skill ini memberikan 130% damage kepada musuh selain hero.
skills.original_description: Kagura sends the Seimei Umbrella to the target location, dealing 365 (+105% total Magic Power) magic damage to enemies in its path and Slowing them by 60% for 0.5 seconds. The Umbrella will automatically return to Kagura when she is too far away. This skill deals 130% damage to non-hero enemies.

skills.name: Rasho Umbrella Flee
skills.description: Kagura berpindah secara instan ke lokasi Payung Seimei dan mengambilnya, sekaligus memberikan 300 (+90% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage kepada musuh di sekitarnya.
skills.original_description: Kagura teleports to the location of the Seimei Umbrella and collects it, dealing 300 (+90% total magic power) magic damage to nearby enemies.

skills.name: Yin Yang Overturn
skills.description: Kagura mereset Cooldown Seimei Umbrella Open, memberikan 235 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage kepada musuh di sekitar Payung Seimei dan mengurangi Movement Speed mereka sebesar 60%. Setelah 1,5 detik, hero lawan di sekitar payung tertarik ke pusat dan menerima 480 (+155% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.
skills.original_description: Kagura resets the cooldown of Seimei Umbrella Open, dealing 235 (+60% total Magic Power) magic damage to enemies around the Seimei Umbrella and Slowing them by 60%. After 1.5 seconds, enemy heroes around the umbrella are pulled towards the center and take 480 (+155% total magic power) magic damage.

skills.name: Wings of Lightning
skills.description: Kerusakan dari skill Kaja memberikan efek kelumpuhan pada unit musuh, yang untuk sementara memperlambat pahlawan atau unit yang dipanggil serta mengurangi kerusakan yang mereka hasilkan sebesar 8% selama 5 detik.
skills.original_description: Kaja's skill damage applies a paralysis effect to enemy units, briefly slowing heroes or summoned units and reducing their damage by 8% for 5 seconds.

skills.name: Ring of Order
skills.description: Kaja memanggil lingkaran Petir Primal yang meluas dan kembali kepadanya. Serangan musuh memantul dan kembali ke arah Kaja. Efek penyembuhan dari serangan berikutnya berkurang menjadi 33%.
skills.original_description: Kaja summons a ring of Primal Lightning that expands and returns to him. The enemies strike and return to Kaja. Healing from subsequent hits is reduced to 33%.

skills.name: Soaring Wings
skills.description: Kaja berlari kencang menuju area target, dan kebal terhadap efek kontrol selama berlari. Setibanya di sana, ia memberikan kerusakan, memantulkan, dan membuat musuh di sekitarnya terpaku selama 0,5 detik, lalu memasuki status Terbang. Status "Soaring" berlangsung selama 6,6 detik. Selama periode ini, ia mengabaikan rintangan dan mendapatkan peningkatan kecepatan gerak sebesar 15%, namun radius beloknya dibatasi. Ia dapat melakukan serangan dasar saat bergerak, memberikan kerusakan sebesar (+2% dari HP maksimum target) kepada musuh di sekitarnya. Saat memasuki status "Soaring", waktu cooldown "Soaring Wings 2" berkurang menjadi 4 detik (tidak terpengaruh oleh pengurangan cooldown). Menyerang Pahlawan atau Creep akan memperpanjang status "Soaring" selama 2,6 detik.
skills.original_description: Kaja dashes towards the target area, gaining control immunity while sprinting. Upon arrival, it deals damage, knocks back and stuns nearby enemies for 0.5 seconds, then enters the Flying state. The Soaring state lasts 6.6 seconds. During this time, he ignores obstacles and gains 15% movement speed, but his turn radius is restricted. He can use basic attacks while moving, dealing (+2% of the target's maximum HP) to surrounding enemies. Upon entering the Soaring state, the cooldown of Soaring Wings 2 is reduced to 4 seconds (unaffected by cooldown reduction). Hitting a Hero or Creep extends the Soaring state by 2.6 seconds.

skills.name: Divine Binding
skills.description: Kaja melemparkan Primal Lightning Laso ke area sasaran. Setelah jeda selama 0,5 detik, semua pahlawan musuh yang masih berada di area tersebut akan ditangkap dan terperangkap selama 2,5 detik. Saat aktif, Kaja dapat menyeret laso tersebut, sehingga mengurangi jangkauannya dan menyeret musuh hingga batas jangkauan (tanpa mengganggu penggunaan skill mereka).
skills.original_description: Kaja throws a Primal Lightning Laso at the target area. After a 0.5 second delay, all enemy heroes remaining in the area are captured and trapped for 2.5 seconds. When active, Kaja can drag the lasso, reducing its radius and dragging enemies to the limit with it (not interrupting their skills).

skills.name: Surge of Life
skills.description: Setelah menggunakan skill, Kalea menciptakan area air di tanah. Saat Kalea menggunakan skill di area ini, ia akan menyerapnya untuk memperkuat tiga serangan dasar berikutnya dengan efek yang berbeda-beda: Serangan Dasar Pertama: Kalea menerjang ke arah target dan memberikan damage. Serangan Dasar Kedua: Kalea melancarkan serangkaian serangan, memberikan kerusakan sekaligus memulihkan HP untuk dirinya sendiri dan sekutu terdekat dengan HP terendah. Serangan Dasar Ketiga: Kalea menggunakan ekornya untuk menyerang area di sekitar sasarannya, memberikan kerusakan sekaligus menciptakan area air baru. Serangan dasar yang ditingkatkan tidak terpengaruh oleh kecepatan serangan.
skills.original_description: After casting a skill, Kalea creates an area of ​​water on the ground. When Kalea casts a skill in this area, she will absorb it to enhance her next three basic attacks with different effects: First Basic Attack: Kalea rushes towards the target and deals damage. Second Basic Attack: Kalea unleashes a flurry of attacks, dealing and recovering HP to herself and the lowest HP nearby ally. Third Basic Attack: Kalea uses her tail to strike the area around her target, inflicting and creating a new area of ​​water. Improved basic attacks are not affected by attack speed.

skills.name: Wavebreaker
skills.description: Kalea menghantamkan tinjunya ke tanah, menciptakan gelombang yang menimbulkan kerusakan pada musuh di sekitarnya dan memperlambat mereka sebesar 40% selama 1,5 detik.
skills.original_description: Kalea slams her fist into the ground, creating a wave that deals damage to nearby enemies and slows them by 40% for 1.5 seconds.

skills.name: Tidal Strike
skills.description: Kalea melesat ke depan dan menyerang pahlawan musuh pertama yang ditemuinya, melemparkannya ke udara selama 0,6 detik sambil memberikan kerusakan. Jika ia menabrak rintangan atau menyentuh tepi area air saat melesat, Kalea akan melompat ke udara. Gunakan kembali skill ini untuk menyerang lokasi target, memberikan damage dan melemparkan musuh ke udara selama 0,6 detik.
skills.original_description: Kalea charges forward and strikes the first enemy hero she encounters, knocking them into the air for 0.6 seconds while dealing with them. If she collides with an obstacle or touches the edge of a water area while charging, Kalea will jump into the air. Cast the skill again to strike a target location, dealing and knocking enemies into the air for 0.6 seconds.

skills.name: Tsunami Slam
skills.description: Kalea menangkap pahlawan musuh dengan ekornya dan menyeretnya ke arah joystick, sehingga menimbulkan kerusakan pada target dan musuh-musuh di sekitarnya.
skills.original_description: Kalea grabs an enemy hero with its tail and swipes it towards the joystick, dealing damage to the target and nearby enemies.

skills.name: Shadow Combo
skills.description: Serangan ketiga berturut-turut Karina terhadap musuh yang sama akan menimbulkan kerusakan sejati tambahan sebesar lebih dari 50% dari HP yang hilang (hingga 2.000 kerusakan sejati terhadap creep). Jika sasarannya adalah pahlawan musuh, waktu cooldown skill Karina yang bukan ultimate akan berkurang sebesar 1,5 detik.
skills.original_description: Karina's third consecutive attack on the same enemy deals additional true damage equal to over 50% of her lost HP (up to 2000 true damage against creeps). If the target is an enemy hero, Karina's non-ultimate skill cooldowns are reduced by 1.5 seconds.

skills.name: Dance of Blades
skills.description: Karina memasuki status Blade Dance selama 3,5 detik; selama itu, ia memperoleh tambahan kecepatan gerak sebesar 45%, memblokir semua serangan dasar yang datang, dan memantulkan serangan tersebut kembali ke penyerang (efek pemantulan kerusakan memiliki cooldown 0,4 detik). Serangan dasar Karina selama periode tersebut akan memperlambat target sebesar 45% selama 1 detik dan menjamin terjadinya serangan kritis. Menggunakan Improved Basic Attack atau Shadow Assault akan mengakhiri status Blade Dance lebih awal.
skills.original_description: Karina enters the Blade Dance state for 3.5 seconds, during which she gains 45% additional movement speed, blocks all incoming basic attacks, and reflects back at the attacker (the damage reflection effect has a 0.4 second cooldown). Karina's basic attack for the duration slows the target by 45% for 1 second and guarantees a critical hit. Casting the Improved Basic Attack or Shadow Assault ends the Blade Dance state prematurely.

skills.name: Dance of Death
skills.description: Karina melancarkan serangan berputar yang menimbulkan kerusakan pada musuh-musuh di sekitarnya.
skills.original_description: Karina launches a spinning attack that deals damage to nearby enemies.

skills.name: Shadow Assault
skills.description: Karina bergegas menuju pahlawan musuh yang menjadi sasaran, memberikan kerusakan serta menerapkan Tanda Bayangan padanya, dan meninggalkan Bentuk Bayangan di tempat tersebut. "Tanda Bayangan" dan "Bentuk Bayangan" keduanya bertahan selama 5 detik. Jika musuh mati selama durasi tersebut, waktu pendinginan (cooldown) skill ini akan disetel ulang. Penggunaan Ulang: Karina berlari menuju lokasi "Bentuk Bayangan", memberikan kerusakan kepada musuh-musuh di sepanjang jalannya.
skills.original_description: Karina rushes to the targeted enemy hero, inflicts and applies a Shadow Mark on them, and leaves a Shadow Form behind. Shadow Mark and Shadow Form both last 5 seconds. If the enemy dies during the duration, the cooldown of this skill is reset. Reuse:|e Karina rushes towards the shadow form|e's location, dealing damage to enemies along the way.

skills.name: Lightwheel Mark
skills.description: Serangan dasar dan skill Karrie memberikan satu tumpukan Lightwheel Mark setiap kali mengenai target. Setelah target memiliki 5 tumpukan, tanda tersebut berubah menjadi Light Wheel yang memberikan True Damage sebesar 6%–8% dari HP maksimum target (maksimal 300 damage terhadap Creep).
skills.original_description: Karrie's basic attacks and skills apply a stack of Lightwheel Mark on a hit. Once a target has 5 stacks of Light Wheel Marks, the marks will transform into a Light Wheel, dealing true damage equal to 6% - 8% of the target's maximum HP (only up to 300 damage against Creeps).

skills.name: Spinning Lightwheel
skills.description: Karrie melepaskan bola energi ke arah yang ditentukan, memberikan damage kepada musuh di sepanjang jalurnya. Bola berhenti saat mengenai hero lawan atau mencapai jarak maksimum, lalu terus memberikan damage kepada musuh di sekitarnya dan mengurangi Movement Speed mereka sebesar 80% selama 1 detik.
skills.original_description: Karrie releases a surging sphere of energy in the targeted direction, dealing damage to enemies in its path. The sphere will stop as soon as it hits an enemy hero or reaches its maximum movement distance, continuously dealing damage to nearby enemies and Slowing them by 80% for 1 second.

skills.name: Phantom Step
skills.description: Karrie melakukan dash ke arah yang ditentukan sambil melemparkan Lightwheel kepada musuh terdekat, memberikan damage dan satu tumpukan Lightwheel Mark. Dalam kondisi Dual Wield, Karrie meluncurkan dua Lightwheel.
skills.original_description: Karrie dashes in the target direction while throwing a Lightwheel at the nearest enemy, dealing and applying a stack of Lightwheel Mark. When in Dual Wield state, Karrie launches two light wheels instead.

skills.name: Speedy Lightwheel
skills.description: Karrie memasuki kondisi Dual Wield selama 6 detik. Selama durasi tersebut, ia memperoleh tambahan Movement Speed sebesar 20% dan meluncurkan dua Lightwheel pada setiap serangan dasar. Masing-masing Lightwheel memberikan 50%–70% damage serangan dasar dan mewarisi sebagian efek serangan.
skills.original_description: Karrie enters the Dual Wield state for 6 sec, during which she gains 20% movement speed and launches two Light Wheels with each basic attack, each dealing 50-70% of basic attack damage and inheriting a portion of attack effects.

skills.name: Sand Walk
skills.description: Khaleed mengumpulkan Desert Power saat bergerak. Setelah terisi penuh, Desert Power membuatnya meluncur di atas pasir, memperoleh tambahan Movement Speed sebesar 35%, memperkuat serangan dasar berikutnya (tidak dapat menghasilkan Critical), dan mengurangi Movement Speed target sebesar 40% selama 1,5 detik.
skills.original_description: Khaleed builds up desert power as he moves. Once Desert Power is fully charged, it will slide across the sand, increasing movement speed by 35%, performing its next basic attack on the target (cannot deal a critical hit), and reducing the target's movement speed by 40% for 1.5 seconds.

skills.name: Desert Tornado
skills.description: Khaleed mengayunkan pedang lengkungnya, memberikan damage kepada musuh di area sekitar dan menarik mereka ke arahnya. Skill ini dapat digunakan hingga 3 kali berturut-turut dan memberikan 50%–75% damage kepada Minion dan Creep.
skills.original_description: Khaleed swings his scimitar, dealing damage to enemies in the area and drawing them towards him. This skill can be used up to 3 times in a row. This skill deals 50-75% damage to minions and Creeps.

skills.name: Quicksand Guard
skills.description: Khaleed melindungi dirinya dengan Power of Quicksand, memulihkan 60–135 HP ditambah 5%–10% dari HP yang hilang serta memperoleh 10 Desert Power setiap 0,5 detik. Selama maksimal 4 detik, damage yang diterima berkurang sebesar 35%–50%. Pasir hisap muncul di bawah kakinya dan memperlambat musuh sebesar 60%. Khaleed tidak dapat menggunakan skill ini jika terkena gangguan.
skills.original_description: Khaleed protects himself with the Power of Quicksand, restoring 60-135 plus 5-10% of his lost HP and 10 Desert Power every 0.5 seconds, reducing damage taken by 35-50% for up to 4 seconds. When channeling, quicksand appears under his feet, slowing the enemy by 60%. This skill is a targeted throw. Any further checks will interrupt this skill.

skills.name: Raging Sandstorm
skills.description: Khaleed menunggangi badai pasir dan menerjang ke lokasi yang ditentukan, memberikan damage kepada musuh di sepanjang jalur serta mendorong mereka ke arah tujuan. Khaleed kebal terhadap efek kontrol selama menerjang. Setibanya di tujuan, ia menghantam tanah, memberikan damage dan menyebabkan stun selama 1 detik kepada musuh di area tersebut, sekaligus mengisi penuh Desert Power.
skills.original_description: Khaleed rides the sandstorm and charges towards a designated location, dealing damage to enemies along the way and knocking them towards his destination. Khaleed is immune to control effects during this process. Upon reaching the destination, Khaleed will crush the ground, dealing damage to enemies in the area and stunning them for 1 second, and fully charge his Desert Power.

skills.name: Spell Curse
skills.description: Setiap 12 detik, Khufra mengaktifkan mantra peninggalan Esmeralda untuk memperkuat serangan dasar berikutnya. Serangan tersebut memiliki jangkauan tambahan, memberikan damage, memperlambat target sebesar 30% selama 1,5 detik, dan memulihkan HP Khufra sebesar 8% dari HP maksimumnya jika mengenai target. Nilai damage tidak tersedia dalam sumber data. Setiap kali skill Khufra memberikan efek kontrol kepada hero musuh, Cooldown Spell Curse berkurang 4 detik.
skills.original_description: Khufra activates the spell left by Esmeralda every 12 seconds, enhancing her next basic attack. Improved Basic Attack gains additional attack range [Cast Range: 4.9] and deals []. Also slows the target by 30% for 1.5 seconds and heals Khufra for 8% of her maximum HP on a hit. Each time Khufra applies a control effect to an enemy hero with her skill, the cooldown of Spell Curse is reduced by 4 seconds.

skills.name: Tyrant's Revenge
skills.description: Khufra menarik perban di lengannya untuk meluncur ke arah yang ditentukan, memberikan 50–100 ditambah 7% dari HP Maksimumnya sebagai Physical Damage kepada semua unit musuh yang berada di jalurnya. Saat melompat ke jarak jauh atau bertemu dengan Pahlawan musuh pertama, Khufra akan segera berhenti, memberikan 50-100 ditambah 7% dari HP Maksimumnya sebagai Physical Damage kepada musuh di sekitarnya, lalu melemparkan mereka ke udara hingga 1,1 detik.
skills.original_description: Khufra pulls the bandage on her arms to launch herself in the specified direction, dealing 50-100 plus 7% of her Max HP physical damage to all enemy units in the path. When blinking far away or encountering the first enemy Hero, Khufra will immediately stop, dealing 50-100 plus 7% of his maximum Physical damage to nearby enemies, then knocking them into the air for up to 1.1 seconds.

skills.name: Bouncing Ball
